name: Sterngrit Ore
description: Gritty iron-rich rock from inner belts; refines mostly into ferrite.

name: Cordite Ore
description: Dense metallic ore with a nickel seam; a reliable mid-tier refinery feed.

name: Lucidite Ore
description: Glassy blue-black ore laced with cobalt and silex; a Fringe favourite.

name: Glacierite Ore
description: Frozen frontier ore that yields glacite crystals and trapped argon.
